key_insight: GDRO makes distributionally robust optimization compatible with generative models by using sample-only Sinkhorn divergence to define adversaries within a chosen generator family.
engineering_relevance: It enables robust decision-making with explicit or implicit conditional generators without needing likelihoods, scores, or access to training data.
method: Treat the nominal model as any sampleable conditional generator.
Restrict worst-case distributions to a chosen generator family.
Use Sinkhorn divergence to compare distributions from samples and solve a differentiable primal-dual problem at the active context.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports substantial gains: 60% lower rare-context inventory regret and 50% fewer SocialGAN navigation collisions versus nominal decisions.
watch_item: Performance and stability may depend on accurate Sinkhorn estimation and careful tuning of the finite-sample primal-dual optimization.
